note: Kazakhstan: no permit of the local executive bodies to employ foreign labour is needed for foreigners working as artists, directors, conductors, choirmasters or ballet masters (балетмейстеры), as for citizens of the EAEU's member states (Government Decree 1041 of 24 November 2023, Annex 1, items 9 and 11, as amended to Decree 643 of 21 July 2026; read 2026-11-03 on Әділет, rendered in a browser, and until then from a copy, since it loads by script); so a performer works there without a work permit, entering and staying on the visa or visa-free stay the visits engine gives, or a residence permit.
